**Microsoft FY2024 Gross Margin**

Both figures come from the same income statement in the FY2024 10-K, so they are directly comparable (same entity, same fiscal-year basis, same presentation):

- Revenue, FY ended June 30, 2024: $245,122 million [DOC-1]
- Cost of revenue, FY ended June 30, 2024: $74,114 million [DOC-1]

Gross margin (gross profit) = $245,122M − $74,114M = **$171,008 million**

Gross margin percentage = $171,008M ÷ $245,122M ≈ **69.8%**

For context, the prior-year comparative in the same filing shows revenue of $211,915 million and cost of revenue of $65,863 million [DOC-1], implying FY2023 gross profit of $146,052 million (68.9% margin) — an increase of roughly $24.96 billion, or about 17%, in FY2024, with margin percentage up about 0.9 percentage points.

ANSWER: $171,008 million gross profit (approximately 69.8% gross margin)
